title: Jabri-web/Jabri-com: v2.0.1 - constraint
description:
A-Phase complete. V1 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20100622 proved Z(x). V2 proves real-valued Z(x) yields S_Z=1.82 < 2 (Bell local bound). This is not a failure but Bell's theorem constraint.

Next B-Phase: Non-factorizable Z(x1,x2) = Z(x1)Z(x2) e^{iPhi(x1,x2)} for entanglement up/down analogy.
